_howto: One entry per NPC the players can meet. Delete the example below and write your own.
established_facts = what was actually PLAYED and is now canon. The GM may narrate it freely.
gm_hypotheses = deductions, intentions and plans. The GM may NOT narrate these as facts,
and an NPC may not act on them until they have been established in play. Keeping the two
apart is what prevents an NPC from 'knowing' something no scene ever taught them — the
single most frequent bug class observed over 34 sessions of real play
connaissances_privees = what this NPC knows and the players do not. Seeded by the GM.
motivations_personnelles = what this NPC wants on their own account; it is what lets them
act between sessions instead of waiting for the players.

npcs.name: EXAMPLE — rename or delete
npcs.description: One or two concrete sentences. Prefer what is perceptible (voice, hands, a habit) over biography.
